programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Arundhati
programme.desc: An idol from a temple in Kshetram is hidden in a forest to protect it from invaders. The Rayulu family tries hard to reinstate it back to the temple in order to complete an old ritual.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Hum Hai Champions
programme.desc: Mallika is blackmailed by a dangerous don to fall in love with his rival's son Panda and eventually murder him. However, Panda is already madly in love with her and does not see what is coming.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Sahadev
programme.desc: An infamous and merciless contract killer percolates through the illegal arms business by taking up the occupation of a cotton farmer.

programme.title: Ek Aur Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: Nakulan and his family move into his supposedly haunted ancestral property. However, when his cousin starts behaving uncharacteristically, Nakulan enlists the help of his psychiatrist friend.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Ek Lahoo
programme.desc: Ashok and Lakshmi share an ideal brother-sister relationship. They find their perfect matches and lead a happily married life until Ashok's wife's aunt comes into their life and creates mayhem.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: John Sturges: The Directors
programme.desc: A fascinating look at the life and career of Oscar-nominated director John Sturges, the mind behind classic films such as The Great Escape and The Magnificent Seven. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: Laurel & Hardy: Their Lives And Magic
programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes documentary shedding new light on the exciting and turbulent private lives of Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy and the genuine friendship between them.

programme.title: Being Mary Tyler Moore
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Documentary chronicling the career of Mary Tyler Moore, highlighting the actress' groundbreaking roles and impact she had on generations of women following in her path.

programme.title: I Am Heath Ledger
programme.desc: Naomi Watts, Ben Mendelsohn, Ang Lee and more pay respects to Heath Ledger in this intimate documentary celebrating the life and work of the great actor, who died on 22 January 2008.

programme.title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A...
programme.desc: The Novichok poisoning of former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in Salisbury sparks an international diplomatic crisis with far-reaching consequences.

programme.title: The Salt Path Scandal
programme.desc: Follow journalist Chloe Hadjimatheou as a tip sparks a probing look into Raynor Winn's beloved memoir, uncovering claims and evidence that challenge The Salt Path's truth.

programme.title: Scientology: Going Clear - The Prison of Belief
programme.desc: Alex Gibney directs an Emmy-nominated documentary profiling eight former members of the Church of Scientology and exploring its history and rise in popularity.

programme.title: Boorman And The Devil
programme.desc: After acclaimed hits, John Boorman takes on The Exorcist II, a notorious failure that nearly ends his career. Years later, cast and filmmakers reassess its ambition and artistic vision.

programme.title: Tales Of The Grim Sleeper
programme.desc: In this immersive film, award-winning documentary maker Nick Broomfield probes the case of the notorious Los Angeles serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper.

programme.title: Fatboy Slim: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: Fatboy Slim's Big Beach Boutique II made history for good and bad reasons. Interviews with the rave-goers, plus old and unseen footage, take us back to a unique point in time.

programme.title: New: Boyzone: One For The Road
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Boyzone as Ronan, Keith, Mikey and Shane reunite for their final two-night shows at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: New: Boyzone: The Final Concert
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Boyzone as Ronan, Keith, Mikey and Shane prepare for their emotional final concert at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: Giroud
programme.desc: Despite constant disrespect, Olivier Giroud always delivered. Hear from France's all-time leading goalscorer and more legends of the game as they discuss the striker's incredible career.

programme.title: Discovering: Jean Simmons
programme.desc: An inside look at the life and career of Emmy and Golden Globe-winning actress Jean Simmons. (S10, ep 5)

programme.title: Discovering: Susan Sarandon
programme.desc: A glimpse into the life and hugely successful career of Academy Award-winning actress and activist, Susan Sarandon. (S10, ep 6)

programme.title: Sergio Leone: The Italian Who...
programme.desc: ...Invented America: An homage to Italian director Sergio Leone, credited as the pioneer of the Spaghetti Western subgenre. Features interviews with Quentin Tarantino and Robert De Niro.

programme.title: Val
programme.desc: An intimate portrait of actor Val Kilmer, whose documentation of his life and craft over four decades comes together for a unique and heartfelt film.

programme.title: Pee-Wee As Himself
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Part one details Reubens' childhood, his personal growth at CalArts, his creation of alter ego of Pee-wee Herman and his journey to becoming a global sensation. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Pee-Wee As Himself
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Go behind the scenes of Pee-wee's Playhouse, as Reubens talks candidly about the highs and lows he endured and shares his final words with the public. (2 of 2)

programme.title: How The Beatles Changed The World
programme.desc: The history of The Beatles and their influence on music, art, culture, fashion and politics. Features new interviews and archive footage of the Fab Four.

programme.title: Boyzone: No Matter What
programme.desc: Love Me for a Reason: Five working-class lads are given the chance to be in one of the biggest boybands. But bitter rifts swiftly emerge and a secret surfaces. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Boyzone: No Matter What
programme.desc: When the Going Gets Tough: The band's success continues as they land their first number one single. But as their popularity soars, so does the tabloid mania. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Boyzone: No Matter What
programme.desc: When All Is Said and Done: The band parts ways, until Mikey proposes a Boyzone reunion. The comeback is a hit, but then tragedy strikes and the tabloids descend. (3 of 3)

programme.title: New: Boyzone: One For The Road
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Boyzone as Ronan, Keith, Mikey and Shane reunite for their final two-night shows at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: New: Boyzone: The Final Concert
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Boyzone as Ronan, Keith, Mikey and Shane prepare for their emotional final concert at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: Amy (2015)
programme.desc: An intimate look into the life and career of British singer Amy Winehouse, with never-before-seen footage and personal testimonials. Asif Kapadia's Oscar-winning documentary.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making Of Motown
programme.desc: Rare performances, interviews and rarely seen footage come together to paint a picture of the history and origins of Motown.

programme.title: The End Of The Storm
programme.desc: The inside story of Liverpool Football Club's 2019-2020 Premier League winning season and the mastermind manager that made it all happen - Jurgen Klopp.

programme.title: The Story Of Late Night
programme.desc: Series tracking the history of late-night TV, featuring stories about hosts such as Johnny Carson, Jay Leno, David Letterman, Jimmy Fallon and more. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Discovering: Christopher Plummer
programme.desc: A look into the life and legacy of Academy Award-winning actor Christopher Plummer, who has sadly passed away. (S10, ep 7)

programme.title: John Frankenheimer: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the award-winning director behind movies such as The Manchurian Candidate, Birdman of Alcatraz, The Train and Ronin. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: The 2000s
programme.desc: Yes We Can: A compelling look back to 2009 when Barack Obama became the 44th President of the United States after one of the most fascinating elections in American history. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: JFK: Destiny Betrayed
programme.desc: Oliver Stone's four-part deep dive into the infamous Kennedy assassination and what happened afterwards, aiming to bring the truth to light. (1 of 4)

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's tour of the UK continues as he uncovers more secrets in urban areas. This week, he's in Brighton where he travels from the toy museum to the Royal Pavilion. (2/8)

programme.title: Red Elvis: The Cold War Cowboy
programme.desc: The extraordinary tale of Dean Reed, the American popstar who packed out stadiums in the 70s and inspired a generation, until he was found drowned in a lake in East Berlin.

programme.title: My Icon: Shaun Gayle
programme.desc: In the next episode of this special series, former Chicago Bears defensive back and Super Bowl winner Shaun Gayle discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life.

programme.title: Lennox Lewis: The Untold Story

programme.title: John Frankenheimer: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the award-winning director behind movies such as The Manchurian Candidate, Birdman of Alcatraz, The Train and Ronin. (S3, ep 6)

programme.desc: Discover who uses their old football stadium as a community allotment. Plus, which club had us retrieving footballs from a river? Including trips to Highfield Road and Ninian Park.

programme.title: Giroud
programme.desc: Despite constant disrespect, Olivier Giroud always delivered. Hear from France's all-time leading goalscorer and more legends of the game as they discuss the striker's incredible career.

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger
programme.desc: The Curse of Brink-Mat: Gangster John Palmer is gunned down in his garden. Ten years later, investigators probe his role in the notorious Brink's-Mat gold heist. (1 of 3)

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger
programme.desc: Empire in the Sun: The search for Palmer's killer leads to Tenerife, where he built a timeshare empire. Undercover stings and mob ties expose the scale of his power. (2 of 3)

programme.title: The Essex Murders: Who Killed Goldfinger

programme.title: Udta Punjab
programme.desc: A rock star, labourer, doctor, and cop struggle with a drug crisis in Punjab. Their lives intertwine as they fight addiction and chaos.

programme.title: Kanjoos Makhichoos
programme.desc: A devoted son secretly saves money to fulfill his father's dream of the Char Dham Yatra. But tragedy strikes when heavy floods hit, and his parents suddenly go missing.

programme.title: Mrs.
programme.desc: Richa thought she found total bliss marrying doctor Diwakar, but domestic routine suffocates her spirit until she finally decides to battle subtle household patriarchy and rebuild her identity.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
programme.desc: Ganga sets out for Calcutta with her son after her husband leaves them. Hoping for a better life, she is betrayed along the way and ends up trapped in a brothel.

programme.title: Iqbal
programme.desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

programme.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

programme.title: Karz
programme.desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

programme.title: Khalnayak
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

programme.title: O'Romeo
programme.desc: A skilled enforcer helps a woman seek justice for her husband's death. As danger grows and enemies close in, their bond deepens amid betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Chaalbaaz
programme.desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Sagar is ready to marry Kavita when he meets Sapna, his former love who is set to marry his childhood friend and life-changing facts surface.

programme.title: International Khiladi
programme.desc: Reporter Payal is sent to interview criminal Devraj. During the interview, they fall in love, but this upsets Devraj's guardian and creates trouble for them.

programme.title: Tapasya
programme.desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

programme.title: Dream Girl
programme.desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

programme.title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
programme.desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

programme.title: Henna
programme.desc: An Indian man falls into a river, losing his memory and drifting into Pakistan. Villagers care for him, but tragedy strikes when his forgotten past painfully resurfaces.

programme.title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
programme.desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

programme.title: Crook
programme.desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

programme.title: Khichdi 2: Mission Paanthukistan
programme.desc: When an intelligence agent discovers Praful's uncanny resemblance to the king of Paanthukistan, he seeks the Parekh family's help to replace the missing monarch and save the kingdom from crisis.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul tries to satisfy his demanding and womanizing boss. Rahul now has to choose between saving innocent Seema or following his dream of becoming big.

programme.title: Zeher
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

programme.title: Biwi No. 1
programme.desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

programme.title: Loafer
programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man, is framed for a gangster's murder. With no support from his family, he must fight alone to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Singh Is King
programme.desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Ghayal
programme.desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

programme.title: Nadiya Ke Paar
programme.desc: Chandan and Gunja, village sweethearts, face heartbreak when Gunja must marry her brother-in-law after her sister's death, forcing them apart and testing their love in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Raid 2
programme.desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

programme.title: Kick
programme.desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

programme.title: Go Goa Gone
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Three friends visit a remote island in Goa for a rave party, but the next morning they wake up stranded and hunted by dangerous, flesh-eating zombies.

programme.title: Tumbbad
programme.desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

programme.title: Badal
programme.desc: After witnessing his family's massacre in a riot, Badal is raised by a terrorist and grows up seeking revenge against the police officer he believes is responsible.

programme.title: Prem Rog
programme.desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
programme.desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

programme.title: Ek Deewane ki Deewaniyat
programme.desc: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their intense romance spirals into a perilous clash of desire and ego, turning love into a battle of passion and heartbreak.

programme.title: Tezaab
programme.desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
programme.desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

programme.title: Kakuda
programme.desc: (Movies @6) A newlywed bride, fearing her husband will die in 13 days due to a village ghost's curse, seeks the help of a ghost hunter to save him from the looming danger.

programme.title: Phone Bhoot
